name: Earning Money
overview: Scripture teaches that earning money should be the result of diligent labor rather than vain or dishonest means, as wealth gained quickly or without effort is unstable, while that accumulated through steady work increases. It also warns of the dangers of debt, highlighting how borrowing places one under the authority of the lender. Ultimately, believers are reminded that their allegiance must be to God alone, not to wealth, since one cannot serve both God and mammon.
